The '''StarMark III Hyperdrive''' was a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive unit]] for [[Starship/Legends|spaceships]] manufactured by [[E'than Hypersystems]]. It was capable of point four past [[Lightspeed/Legends|lightspeed]]<ref name="JGG" /> and was similar in appearance to the [[T-14 hyperdrive generator/Legends|T-14]], a different brand of hyperdrive generator commonly found on the starships made by [[Nubia Star Drives, Incorporated/Legends|Nubia Star Drives, Incorporated]].<ref name="FF6">{{FactFile|6|NAB 1-2|Naboo Royal Starship}}</ref> At some point before the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing/Legends|podrace]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Timeline">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' states that the events of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] took place in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], and the [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|podracer]] [[Ratts Tyerell/Legends|Ratts Tyerell]] [[Death/Legends|died]] during the film. As Tyerell was shown to be alive in ''[[Star Wars Math: Jabba's Game Galaxy]]'', the events of the game must have taken place before the events of ''The Phantom Menace''.</ref> it could be purchased on the remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="JGG" /> It cost 2,500 [[Wupiupi/Legends|wupiupi]], which was worth 1,562 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] at the [[Time/Legends|time]].<ref name="SOT" />
{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
At that [[Time/Legends|time]], an [[Unidentified extra-galactic spacer|extra–galactic spacer]] who had crashed on Tatooine bought a StarMark III Hyperdrive from a [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealer]] named [[Watto/Legends|Watto]], so they could repair their [[Unidentified starship (marooned spacer)|damaged starship]] and leave the planet.<ref name="JGG" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The StarMark III Hyperdrive appeared in the [[2000]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Math: Jabba's Game Galaxy]]'', released by [[Lucas Learning]]. Using credits earned in the various activities of the game, the player could collect parts and pieces used in the rebuilding of a crashed spaceship. The StarMark III Hyperdrive was one of the available parts. That item was essential to finish the game, as the player could not get off Tatooine with the mended ship without a hyperdrive unit.<ref name="JGG" />
